mechanism: Sodium valproate inhibits primidone metabolism via CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, increasing primidone levels and CNS toxicity risk, while primidone may induce valproate metabolism reducing its efficacy.
action: Monitor serum levels of both drugs closely; adjust primidone and valproate doses accordingly and observe for signs of primidone toxicity (ataxia, drowsiness, nystagmus).
